description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rajanganaya, Rajanganaya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110135 (22/0832)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining titles to specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, and location details) in Rajanganaya, along with a detailed schedule showing ownership particulars, extents, and encumbrances for each land parcel. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns land registration and title determination.
